$comment: tests/harness/idle (W-V0b). Per segment, the most frames per second each channel may draw (frames, scene, composite, eyepiece, readback) and the most infinite animations running when the window opens; a missing key is reported, not asserted. 'assert' holds only what the build met when W-V0b measured it (reference host, 2026-10-29, D2: intro 240 fps at a 240 Hz display, the EVF 30 fps, hidden and reduced 0; WebKit intro 20 to 27, EVF 15 to 24; CI at G1: WebKit's EVF 31 fps, on a frame clock that is not a 60 Hz vsync). The EVF's 32 is the engine's own rest cap: it draws when 1000 / 30 - 2 ms have passed, so at most 31.9 fps. 'd053' is D-053's targets (budgets.md Life at rest), reported per segment; W-V3 moves them into 'assert' (and adds the 60 s stop). traceCrossCheck: in Chromium the engine's presented frames may never exceed the trace's rAF callbacks.
